cop.why: The law faction and its archetype already read 'Spore Warden' in both swamp packs.

police.why: Mass noun for the same faction; the colony has wardens, not police.

thug.why: The melee archetype is drawn and named 'Bog Mutant' (bog-mutant cast walk).

gangster.why: The pistol hunter is the Rootcult's; acolyte names a cult member without modern crime.

enforcer.why: 'Rootcult Enforcer' is mob-muscle wording for the same archetype.

gang.why: The faction that holds the Rootcult Acolyte and is hostile on sight; its label already reads 'Rootcult'.

bouncer.why: The peaceful-until-hit door guard is drawn as the 'Airlock Warden'; a lockkeeper keeps the airlock.

officer.why: The raid's command role (bellwether, medic, sapper); 'bellwether' is already an archetype, so the role gets its own word.

heist.why: The bunker objective run is a colony salvage dive, not a robbery.

crime.why: Attacking settlers in view of the wardens; a misdeed carries no police-procedural frame.

criminal.why: Who the wardens chase; no legal-system frame.

law.why: 'The law' means the warden faction; 'watch' is already an identifier (debug-cli).

lawful.why: Hostility value for wardens: only aggro on troublemakers.

robber.why: Cops-and-robbers framing; 'raider' is already an AI behavior id.

thief.why: A test player's name; 'scavenger' is already an AI behavior id.

dcop.why: Test-local delta variable fused with cop.

dthug.why: Test-local delta variable fused with thug.

dgang.why: Test-local delta variable fused with gang.

street.why: The outdoor floors are a sunken colony; its open ground is raised causeways over bog, not Earth streets.

sidewalk.why: The walkway beside a causeway is a boardwalk over the swamp.

briefcase.why: The objective already reads 'Specimen Canister' to players; 'keycard' is taken by the wing keycard archetype.

bat.why: Colony melee is its maintenance kit; the lore-weapons work makes the bat a pipe wrench (wrench essence = weight/knockback).
